title: Foundation: after 11-year school
lead: School in Uzbekistan lasts 11 years. A bachelor's degree in Italy usually requires 12 years of schooling. Foundation is a preparatory course that fills this one-year gap: once you complete it, you can apply for a bachelor's.

facts.d: Those who want to enter a bachelor's with an 11-year certificate. The alternative: study for 1 year at a university in Uzbekistan and then apply directly for a bachelor's.

A separate student visa is issued for Foundation. According to the MUR circular, there is no strict deadline for Foundation courses, but you should apply no later than the start of classes. The Tashkent embassy's list is called «Study enrolment and foundation years».
Most often taught in English. Tor Vergata requires at least B1 English for 2027/28; Pavia also asks visa applicants for a B1 Italian certificate.
Foundation is paid even at state universities: usually 5 000 – 7 500 € (see the table below). This is separate from the bachelor's tuition fee.
